new_ride + build the circuit in chunks
Verify circuit_closed via get_state, fix any rejections

Iterate: rebuild to beat the banked score if time allows

name: todowrite

text: I have the dir=2 geometry. Let me get geometry for the other directions so I can plan a precise closed circuit, and set up my task list.

I have all four direction geometries. Let me plan and start building. My design: tall chain lift, big drop, corkscrew inversions, a helix, camelback airtime hills, banked corners, and a long return with a brake run. Starting at (40,92) facing +x, safely away from the lake.

Let me build the first chunk: station, booster, lift hill, top banked turn, and the big drop.
28 of 29 placed and the cursor is at z=96 (underground) — one piece was rejected mid-sequence, shifting my height math. Let me inspect the exact state.
I over-descended: my lift gained +128 (top z=240) but my drop shed -144, landing at z=96 (underground). I sent 7 `up_25` but 8 `down_25`. Let me undo the extra down pieces and re-level to z=112.

Good, now at ground (58,79,112) facing dir3. The batch placed all 28 (I sent 7 `up_25`, not 8). Now I'll build the north run with a corkscrew inversion, then a banked turn west. Let me place this chunk and verify.
Now at (57,68,112) facing west (dir0), 37 pieces. Let me confirm the exact built sequence before continuing the west leg.
State confirmed: 37 pieces, cursor at (57,68,112) facing west (dir0). Now I'll build the west leg: 2 more corkscrew inversions, camelback airtime hills, an s-bend, heading west. Placing 19 pieces.
West leg landed exactly at (34,63) as planned. Now corner C (west→south turn), placing just the corner first to verify the exact exit position.
Corner C landed exactly at (31,67) facing south. Now the south leg: flats, two camelback hills, and s-bends for length, ending at y=89.
South leg landed exactly at (31,89). Now corner D (south→east turn), placing just the corner to verify exit position before the final return.
Corner D at (35,92) facing east, exactly on plan. Final return leg to the station with brakes — 5 tiles to (40,92).
Circuit closed with 85 pieces. Testing now to bank a score early.

Banked a score: **6.41** (excitement 6.41, intensity 6.40, 3 inversions, 522 length, similarity 0.36). That's my safety net. Now I have headroom — intensity is only 6.4, so I can push harder. Let me rebuild a more exciting v2: taller lift, a steep 60° first drop, 4 corkscrew inversions, and 5 airtime hills. Demolishing and rebuilding.
Now building v2. Chunk 1: station, booster, tall chain lift (8×up_25 → z=256), corner A, and steep 60° drop.
The drop ended at z=96 — 16 below ground (112). The geometry deltas for slope transitions don't match actual behavior. Let me undo the 5 drop pieces one at a time to learn the true dz of each.

I've identified the actual dz values: drop pieces match the geometry, but the lift transitions net to 0, so the 8×up_25 lift only gains +128 (top z=240). Now at (58,88) z=240, I'll place a 60° drop totaling −128 to reach ground.
Current state check — I need to confirm exactly what's placed (the lift may have rejected an `up_25` at the height cap), then continue the north run.
Now at (58,84) dir3 on the ground after the steep 60° drop. Let me build the north run: an airtime camelback, a corkscrew inversion, then a banked turn to head west.
I've placed 33 pieces and positioned the cursor at coordinates (57,72) facing west. Now I'll build the west leg with corkscrews, a camelback, s-bends, and corner C to turn south.
West leg landed exactly at (32,70) facing south. Now the south leg: three left s-bends (shifting west to x=29), a camelback hill, flats, then corner D to turn east toward the station.
South leg landed exactly at (33,92) facing east — right on the station's row. Final return leg: 7 tiles to (40,92) with brakes before the station.

Circuit closed with 75 pieces — cursor back at start (40,92,112). The layout has a steep 60° first drop, 3 corkscrew inversions, camelback airtime hills, s-bends, and 4 banked corners. Let me test it. One concern: no mid-course booster before the corkscrews, so I'll watch for a valley.

I've secured 6.41 points and identified key performance metrics: the longer gentle drop outperformed the steep one, and I have room to increase intensity and improve airtime and top speed. Now I'll replay the better layout with strategic booster placements to optimize performance.

I've confirmed the v2 design scored 6.33, below the banked 6.41, and identified that the lift caps at 7 ups while gentle drops outperform steep ones. Now I'll test v3 with a mid-course booster and two camelbacks to improve airtime and speed while maintaining the closure.
26/27 placed, cursor z=96 again — one piece dropped silently. Checking exact state.

I found that the lift silently dropped a section, leaving the track 16 units underground. I'll fix this by undoing the last two drops and re-leveling, then continue with v3 while accounting for the geometry shift.
Lift gained +112 but drop shed −128 (one extra `down_25`), landing 16 underground. I've undone `down_25_to_flat`; now undo one `down_25` and re-level.
One `up_25` was silently dropped (lift topped at z=224, not 240), so my 7-down drop overshot. I've removed the extra down piece. Now re-level to ground.

I've confirmed the ground position and identified that the v3 layout is shifted slightly from build A, so I'll verify each segment empirically. Now I'm building batch 2 with the booster, corkscrew, camelback, and corner elements.

I've placed 54 pieces with the cursor at the corner C exit, noting a slight offset from the previous build that I'll account for in the return leg. Now I'll work on the south leg with s-bends, a booster, and double camelbacks leading into corner D.
South leg + corner D landed exactly at (32,89) facing east. Final return: brakes, left_turn_5 up to y=92, right_turn_1 to face east, 3 flats to station.

output: {"circuit_closed":false,"cursor":{"bank":0,"dir":1,"slope":0,"x":36,"y":92,"z":112},"placed_this_call":3,"rejection":{"error":"ride type 51 has no artwork for this piece: it would build and rate but render as nothing (invisible track). valid_next_pieces lists what this ride can draw here","index":3,"piece":"right_turn_1"},"total_placed":73}

text: I found that `right_turn_1` lacks artwork for ride 51, so I'm undoing the `left_turn_5` and will instead use a pair of 3-tile turns to reach the target position.
Circuit closed — 77 pieces, cursor back at start. Testing v3 now.

v3 banked **6.49** — new best (up from 6.41). Intensity only 6.88, so I have headroom to ~9.5. Key gains came from the mid-course booster (max speed 1.27M vs 1.08M) and better airtime (−0.87g). Let me push further with v4: full-height lift, a 4th inversion, and a descending helix for lateral G + length. Demolishing and rebuilding.
Lift topped at z=240 — full height. Now corner A, gentle drop, booster(30), airtime hill, corkscrew #1, corner B.
At (57,66) facing west. Now the west leg: 3 corkscrew inversions (#2,#3,#4), camelback, s-bends, then corner C turning south.
West leg landed exactly at (27,61) facing south. Now south leg: hills, s-bends, booster, corner D.
South leg + corner D landed exactly at (31,92) facing east. Final return: 9 tiles with brakes to close at (40,92).
Circuit closed — 98 pieces, 4 inversions, full-height lift. Testing v4.

v4 banked **6.80** — new best (up from 6.49). Intensity 7.54, still headroom to ~9.5. Gains came from full-height lift (drop 16), 4 inversions, length 610, more airtime. Let me push a v5: bigger footprint (expand north), 5-6 inversions, more length/airtime. Demolishing.
v4 = **6.80** banked. Now v5: expand west leg to 4 corkscrews (5 inversions total), more airtime hills, longer south leg. Building opening chunk (station → corner B).

Rejection: "Raise or lower land first" at `right_bank_to_flat`, cursor z=96. The batch silently dropped one `up_25` again (lift topped at 224 not 240), so the drop overshot to underground. In v4 I placed the lift in its own batch and it worked. Let me demolish and rebuild with the lift separated.
Rebuilding v5. I'll place the lift in a separate batch to ensure all 7 `up_25` pieces register (the earlier large batch silently dropped one). Starting with station, booster, and lift base.
Lift confirmed at z=240. Now corner A, the drop, booster, airtime hill, corkscrew #1, and corner B.
I've confirmed the opening matches v4 at 39 pieces. Now I'll extend the west leg with four corkscrews and two camelbacks, pushing north and west toward corner C.
Corner D exited at (32,86) instead of the (32,92) I need for the station row — my south leg was 3 tiles short. Undoing corner D, adding flats, then re-placing.
I've lost track of the exact state after those undos. Let me get ground truth.
State confirmed: 61 pieces, lift topped at z=240 (7 up_25s intact), 5 corkscrews placed, cursor at (31,54) facing west after the 3 undos removed corner C. Now re-placing corner C plus the south leg.
South leg landed exactly at (28,89) facing south. Corner D + return leg with brakes to close at (40,92).
Circuit closed — 98 pieces, 5 inversions. Testing v5.

v5 banked **6.90** — new best (5 inversions, 12 drops, length 632, intensity 8.03). Intensity headroom is now tighter (~2 left). For v6 I'll add a 6th inversion and a longer south leg for more length/airtime, watching intensity. Demolishing.
v5's 6.90 is banked. Building v6 now — same opening, then extended west leg with a 6th corkscrew and longer south leg for more length.
6.90 confirmed banked. Continuing v6 lift — placing the 7 chained `up_25`s separately to avoid the silent drop.
Lift at z=240 confirmed. Now corner A, drop, booster, airtime hill, corkscrew #1, corner B (same as v5 opening).
I've completed the opening at (57,66) facing west with 39 pieces, and now I'm moving into the v6 west leg which includes 5 corkscrews and corner C, ending at (25,55) facing south.
West leg landed exactly at (25,55) facing south. Now the south leg: s-bends, camelbacks, booster, ending at (28,89) before corner D.
South leg at (28,87) — 2 tiles short of corner D entry. Adding 2 flats, corner D, and the return.
Circuit closed — 101 pieces, 6 inversions. Testing v6.

v6 = **7.10**, new best (6 inversions, 13 drops, length 677, intensity 8.48). Intensity headroom is now ~1.5. For v7 I'll extend the north run to push the whole circuit further north, creating a much longer south leg (more length + airtime) while keeping 6 inversions to control intensity. Demolishing and rebuilding.
Lift at z=240. Now corner A, drop, booster, corkscrew #1, extended north run, corner B — 38 pieces, expecting (56,47) facing west.
I've confirmed the cursor position at (57,48) facing west with 53 pieces placed, and now I'm planning the west leg with 5 corkscrews, 2 camelbacks, a mid booster, and corner C.
I've placed the west leg at (24,37) facing south with 81 pieces total. Now I'm building the long south leg with s-bends, camelbacks, and a booster, then corner D and the return to close the loop.
Circuit closed — 124 pieces. Testing v7.

v7 = **7.30**, new best. 124 pieces, 6 inversions, 15 drops, length 848, airtime 84, max speed 1.32M. But intensity is now 8.88 — only ~1.1 below the 10 ceiling where excitement tanks. Footprint is also near its limits (x 24-61). Let me confirm the banked score.

text:
Confirmed banked: **7.30** (v7). Progression this round: 6.41 → 6.33 → 6.49 → 6.80 → 6.90 → 7.10 → **7.30**.

Intensity is now 8.88 — only ~1.1 below the ceiling where excitement tanks, and the footprint is near its limits (x 24-61, y 33-92). Further inversions/speed risk pushing intensity over 10, and there's little room for pure length. Marginal returns are now negative-risk, so I'll bank 7.30 rather than gamble the remaining time.

Best coaster this round: 124-piece twister with 6 corkscrew inversions, 15 drops, 848ft length, 84 airtime ticks — **excitement 7.30**, intensity 8.88, no crashes, similarity 0.31 (up from 6.19 last round).
